release_notes:
- Scanned PDFs: when a PDF is a scanned image with no text, Nexus now reads it with OCR, so AI features, the Reader and imports see its content instead of an empty page.
- Project summary: the PICO/SPIDER boxes and the secondary objectives now grow as you type, so long answers are no longer cut off.
- Project summary: new "Rewrite with AI" button. It rewrites your main objective so it is correctly defined, without adding anything you did not write. You can undo it.
- Citation Chaser: the search now runs in the background. You can close the progress window and keep working, or stop the search.
- Citation Chaser: the network graph no longer freezes the app after a large search.
- Library: "Send to Citation Chaser" now sends every selected paper, not only the first one.
- Updates: the update and reconnect notices now show a clear icon for each case instead of always a warning sign.
